description: Use whenever the user asks how deep a gas can go or checks an existing breathing gas (nitrox, trimix, CCR diluent) against a depth, even if they don't mention In Da Mix; never work a MOD out by hand. Maximum operating depth of a breathing gas: the MOD by the ppO2 limit (as on a cylinder label), and for hypoxic gases the minimum depth. With complete: true also the complete MOD, the deepest depth within the ppO2, END and gas density limits together, with the limit that sets it. Call it with only the gas (o2_percent, he_percent) and the dive mode: leave ppo2_bar out unless the user gave one, so the In Da Mix setting is used. Answer: the gas and its MOD, the ppO2 limit used and the dive mode (and the minimum depth for a hypoxic gas); nothing else, no table of other ppO2 values, no ppO2 recommendation of your own. Then ask whether to also calculate the complete MOD within the END and gas density limits; if yes, call it again with complete: true (same gas and mode). Only when the user asks for END, density or all the limits, call with complete: true at once, and answer: the complete MOD and the limit that sets it, the MOD by ppO2, END and gas density at the complete MOD, and the limits used; report limits_check as it is (a value at its limit complies). Use for "what is the MOD of EAN32", "max depth for NX38", "how deep can I take 18/45", "can I take air to 50 m", "can I use 10/70 at 65 m", "is this diluent OK for 70 m", "koja je maksimalna dubina za NX38", "koliko duboko mogu s 18/45", "je li 12/65 dobar za 65 metara".

complete.description: Also the complete MOD (within the END and gas density limits too). Leave it out at first; set true only when the user says yes to it. Giving max_end or max_density_g_per_l turns it on.

depth_unit.description: Unit of every depth in the question and the answer.

dive_mode.description: Open circuit (OC) or closed-circuit rebreather (CCR). Sets which defaults apply (from the In Da Mix settings: ppO2, END, density, O2 narcotic). The values used are listed in `assumed`.

he_percent.description: Helium in the gas, percent (0 for nitrox).

include_steps.description: Also return the app's ƒx steps ("How this was calculated"): every formula with its numbers. Long: only when the user asks how it was calculated.

language.description: Language of the texts in the answer: en (English) or hr (Croatian). Use the user's language.

max_density_g_per_l.description: Maximum gas density for the complete MOD, g/L. Default from the In Da Mix settings for the dive mode; the value used is listed in `assumed`.

max_end.description: Maximum END for the complete MOD, in depth_unit. Default from the In Da Mix settings for the dive mode; the value used is listed in `assumed`.

o2_narcotic.description: Count O2 as narcotic in the END. Default from the In Da Mix settings for the dive mode; the value used is listed in `assumed`.

o2_percent.description: Oxygen in the gas, percent (32 for EAN32, 18 for trimix 18/45).

ppo2_bar.description: ppO2 limit, bar. Default from the In Da Mix settings for the dive mode; the value used is listed in `assumed`.
